blocks.en: Appendices 5-8: FMEA Example, Technology Transfer Report Format, References and Glossary

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 FMEA（失效模式與效果分析）的完整評分邏輯：嚴重度 / 發生率 / 偵測度 → RPN，以及何時需要採取行動
blocks.en: Understand the full scoring logic of FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis): severity / occurrence / detectability → RPN, and when action is required

blocks.zh: 將非無菌藥品的 FMEA 範例，對應應用到無菌製程技術轉移中更高風險的失效模式（無菌性、微粒、容器密封完整性）
blocks.en: Map the non-sterile drug product FMEA example onto the higher-risk failure modes of a sterile process technology transfer (sterility, particulates, container closure integrity)

blocks.zh: 掌握技術轉移完成報告的完整結構，了解其對法規申報（CMC）的重要性
blocks.en: Grasp the complete structure of the technology transfer completion report and its importance for regulatory filings (CMC)

blocks.zh: 識別技術轉移的法規錨點文件：ICH Q10、Q8(R2)、Q9、Q11 及 FDA 可比性指引
blocks.en: Identify the regulatory anchor documents for technology transfer: ICH Q10, Q8(R2), Q9, Q11 and the FDA comparability guidance

blocks.zh: 釐清最常混淆的術語：可比性 vs. 分析相似性；技術包裝 vs. 技術轉移提案；PPQ vs. 製程驗證
blocks.en: Clarify the most commonly confused terms: comparability vs. analytical similarity; technology transfer package vs. technology transfer proposal; PPQ vs. process validation

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — FMEA 評分三要素
blocks.en: Core Concepts — The Three FMEA Scoring Factors

blocks.zh: RPN = SEV × OCC × DET（風險優先數 = 嚴重度 × 發生率 × 偵測度）
blocks.en: RPN = SEV × OCC × DET (Risk Priority Number = Severity × Occurrence × Detectability)

blocks.zh: SEV（嚴重度）：失效對患者 / 產品品質的影響程度。1 = 微乎其微，10 = 危及生命。
blocks.en: SEV (Severity): The impact of the failure on the patient / product quality. 1 = negligible, 10 = life-threatening.

blocks.zh: OCC（發生率）：該失效原因實際發生的頻率。1 = 極少見，10 = 幾乎確定發生。
blocks.en: OCC (Occurrence): How often the cause of the failure actually occurs. 1 = very rare, 10 = almost certain to occur.

blocks.zh: DET（偵測度）：現有管制措施能「偵測到」問題的能力。注意：偵測度越低 = 越容易偵測 = 分數越低；偵測度越高 = 越難發現 = 分數越高。
blocks.en: DET (Detectability): The ability of existing controls to "detect" the problem. Note: a lower DET score = easier to detect; a higher DET score = harder to detect.

blocks.zh: 此表中所有 DET = 8，表示偵測難度偏高——IPC 每隔數小時才查一次，無法即時攔截問題。
blocks.en: In this table every DET = 8, indicating poor detectability: IPC is performed only every few hours, so problems cannot be intercepted in real time.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 為什麼 DET = 8 是個警訊
blocks.en: Analogy — Why DET = 8 Is a Warning Sign

blocks.zh: 想像你在高速公路上開車，測速攝影機每 4 小時才拍一次——超速的人幾乎都能全身而退。IPC 每 4 小時才做一次崩解度檢查，就像那種「幾乎沒有威脅力」的偵測。DET 分數 8/10 代表：就算有問題，我們也不容易及時抓到。
blocks.en: Imagine driving on a highway where the speed camera takes a photo only once every 4 hours: almost every speeder gets away with it. An IPC disintegration check performed only every 4 hours is that kind of "barely threatening" detection. A DET score of 8/10 means that even when there is a problem, we are unlikely to catch it in time.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — RPN 門檻與觸發行動
blocks.en: Key Point — RPN Thresholds and Triggering Action

blocks.zh: 表中以「•」標記的兩個 RPN = 160 需要行動：
blocks.en: The two RPN = 160 entries marked with "•" in the table require action:

blocks.zh: 沖頭破裂未找到碎片（SEV=10）：對非無菌錠劑 SEV=10，因為錠劑中可能含有金屬異物，直接危害患者安全。偵測依賴金屬偵測器，但仍有漏網風險。
blocks.en: Punch breakage, fragments not found (SEV=10): For a non-sterile tablet SEV=10, because tablets may contain metal foreign matter that directly endangers patient safety. Detection relies on a metal detector, but there is still a risk of escape.

blocks.zh: 錠劑表面黑點（SEV=10）：外觀缺陷在最嚴格解讀下被評為 10（可能表示污染）。
blocks.en: Black spots on tablet surface (SEV=10): Under the strictest interpretation, a visual defect is rated 10 (it may indicate contamination).

blocks.zh: RPN 通常在 100–125 以上就需要採取行動，各公司可自行設定門檻，但必須在 FMEA SOP 中明文規定。
blocks.en: Action is usually required at an RPN of about 100–125 or above. Each company may set its own threshold, but it must be stated explicitly in the FMEA SOP.

blocks.zh: 延伸應用 — 無菌製程中 FMEA 的嚴重度如何不同
blocks.en: Extended Application — How FMEA Severity Differs in Sterile Processes

blocks.zh: 本例為非無菌藥品。若對應到無菌製程技術轉移，以下失效模式的 SEV 會顯著更高：
blocks.en: This example is a non-sterile drug product. Mapped onto a sterile process technology transfer, the SEV of the following failure modes becomes significantly higher:

blocks.zh: 無菌完整性失效（Sterility breach）→ SEV = 10（患者感染風險直接）
blocks.en: Sterility breach → SEV = 10 (direct risk of infection to the patient)

blocks.zh: 微粒異物（Particulate contamination）→ SEV = 9–10（靜脈注射可致命）
blocks.en: Particulate contamination → SEV = 9–10 (can be fatal for intravenous products)

blocks.zh: 容器密封完整性失效（CCI failure）→ SEV = 9（無法保證無菌至效期）
blocks.en: Container closure integrity (CCI) failure → SEV = 9 (sterility cannot be assured through to expiry)

blocks.zh: 標示錯誤→ SEV = 9（用藥錯誤）
blocks.en: Labeling error → SEV = 9 (medication error)

blocks.zh: 這就是為何無菌製程 FMEA 幾乎所有主要失效模式 SEV 都是 8–10，RPN 動輒超過閾值，需要更嚴密的 OCC 控制（降低發生率）和 DET 強化（如 100% 線上監控）。
blocks.en: This is why almost all major failure modes in a sterile process FMEA carry SEV of 8–10 and RPNs routinely exceed the threshold, calling for tighter OCC control (lower occurrence) and stronger DET (for example, 100% in-line monitoring).

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 — 降低 RPN 的策略
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation — Strategies to Reduce RPN

blocks.zh:
RPN = SEV × OCC × DET

策略一：降低 OCC（改善製程穩定性）
  例：強化沖頭維護保養計畫 → OCC: 2 → 1
  RPN: 160 → 80 ✓

策略二：降低 DET（改善偵測能力）
  例：由每 4 小時 IPC → 即時 100% 視覺檢查
  DET: 8 → 3
  RPN: 160 → 60 ✓

策略三：兩者並行
  OCC: 2→1, DET: 8→4 → RPN: 160 → 40 ✓✓

注意：SEV 難以降低（失效的影響由產品
性質決定），故應優先降低 OCC 和 DET。
blocks.en:
RPN = SEV × OCC × DET

Strategy 1: Reduce OCC (improve process stability)
  Example: strengthen the punch maintenance program → OCC: 2 → 1
  RPN: 160 → 80 ✓

Strategy 2: Reduce DET (improve detection capability)
  Example: from IPC every 4 hours → real-time 100% visual inspection
  DET: 8 → 3
  RPN: 160 → 60 ✓

Strategy 3: Do both
  OCC: 2→1, DET: 8→4 → RPN: 160 → 40 ✓✓

Note: SEV is hard to reduce (the impact of a failure is
determined by the nature of the product), so prioritize
reducing OCC and DET.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為何此 FMEA 中所有失效模式的 DET 都是 8？如果改為每批次 100% 自動光學檢查（AOI），DET 會降到多少？對 RPN 的影響是什麼？
blocks.en: Why is DET = 8 for every failure mode in this FMEA? If it were changed to 100% automated optical inspection (AOI) of every batch, what would DET drop to, and what would the effect on RPN be?

blocks.zh: 在無菌充填技術轉移中，「IPC 每 4 小時」這樣的偵測頻率是否可接受？請說明為何無菌製程需要更高頻率或連續監控。
blocks.en: In a sterile filling technology transfer, is a detection frequency such as "IPC every 4 hours" acceptable? Explain why sterile processes need higher-frequency or continuous monitoring.

blocks.zh: OCC = 1 代表發生率極低，但該失效的 RPN 仍為 40。請問在 TT 接收端，你會如何確認 OCC 評估的合理性（即如何驗證發送端的歷史資料可適用於接收端）？
blocks.en: OCC = 1 means a very low occurrence, yet the RPN of that failure is still 40. At the TT receiving unit, how would you confirm that the OCC assessment is reasonable (that is, how would you verify that the sending unit's historical data apply to the receiving unit)?

blocks.zh: Appendix 6 — Example of Information that May be Included in Technology Transfer Report Appendix 6 — 技術轉移報告可能包含的資訊範例
blocks.en: Appendix 6 — Example of Information that May be Included in Technology Transfer Report

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 技術轉移報告的定位
blocks.en: Core Concepts — The Role of the Technology Transfer Report

blocks.zh: 技術轉移報告（Technology Transfer Report）是整個 TT 專案的最終交付物，它的功能不只是記錄「做了什麼」，更重要的是建立法規可見性：向監管機構證明技術轉移已完成，且接收端的產品與發送端具有可比性（Comparability）。
blocks.en: The Technology Transfer Report is the final deliverable of the whole TT project. It does more than record "what was done": above all it establishes regulatory visibility, demonstrating to regulators that the technology transfer is complete and that the receiving unit's product is comparable to the sending unit's (Comparability).

blocks.zh: 這份報告在 CMC 法規申報中是關鍵證據，特別是當：
blocks.en: This report is key evidence in CMC regulatory filings, particularly when:

blocks.zh: 新增生產地點（Site transfer → 需更新 DMF / MAA）
blocks.en: Adding a manufacturing site (site transfer → DMF / MAA must be updated)

blocks.zh: 規模放大（Scale-up → 需展示批次間可比性數據）
blocks.en: Scaling up (scale-up → batch-to-batch comparability data must be shown)

blocks.zh: 分析方法轉移（Method transfer → 需有轉移驗證結果）
blocks.en: Transferring analytical methods (method transfer → method transfer validation results are needed)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — TT 報告像什麼
blocks.en: Analogy — What Is a TT Report Like?

blocks.zh: 技術轉移報告就像一間餐廳的「品牌授權文件包」。當麥當勞把配方授權給新加盟商時，不只是交一份食譜，還要附上：原料清單、每批次抽驗記錄、設備規格書、清潔驗證、員工培訓記錄。TT 報告的作用就是確保接收端（新加盟商）能按照相同標準製作出「一樣的」產品——且有文件可以向稽查員證明這一點。
blocks.en: A technology transfer report is like a restaurant's "brand licensing document package". When McDonald's licenses its recipe to a new franchisee, it does not just hand over a recipe; it also supplies the ingredient list, batch sampling records, equipment specifications, cleaning validation and staff training records. The TT report serves to ensure that the receiving unit (the new franchisee) can make the "same" product to the same standard, with documents to prove it to an inspector.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 報告必須涵蓋的六個核心模組
blocks.en: Key Point — The Six Core Modules a Report Must Cover

blocks.zh: 雖然 Appendix 6 以核查清單呈現，但完整的 TT 報告應包含以下六個核心敘事模組：
blocks.en: Although Appendix 6 is presented as a checklist, a complete TT report should contain the following six core narrative modules:

blocks.zh: 執行摘要（Executive Summary）：TT 範疇、關鍵結論、剩餘未解決事項
blocks.en: Executive Summary: TT scope, key conclusions, remaining open items

blocks.zh: 範疇與團隊（Scope & Team）：RACI、角色、里程碑
blocks.en: Scope & Team: RACI, roles, milestones

blocks.zh: 開發資訊（Development Info）：配方史、製程理解、風險評估
blocks.en: Development Info: formulation history, process understanding, risk assessment

blocks.zh: 生產資訊（Production Info）：批次記錄、設備確效、清潔驗證
blocks.en: Production Info: batch records, equipment qualification, cleaning validation

blocks.zh: PPQ 結果（PPQ Outcomes）：製程性能確效批次的統計比較
blocks.en: PPQ Outcomes: statistical comparison of the process performance qualification batches

blocks.zh: 核准簽署（Approval Signatures）：發送端 QA + 接收端 QA 雙方確認
blocks.en: Approval Signatures: confirmation by both the sending unit QA and the receiving unit QA

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 場景：誰來撰寫 TT 報告？
blocks.en: Practical Application — CDMO Scenario: Who Writes the TT Report?

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，TT 報告通常由接收端（CDMO）技術服務部門主筆，但需要客戶（發送端）提供開發資訊章節的素材。常見的痛點是：客戶以「商業機密」為由不願提供完整配方開發史，但這些資訊對接收端理解製程關鍵點至關重要。
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, the TT report is usually authored by the receiving unit's (the CDMO's) technical services department, but it needs the client (sending unit) to supply the material for the development information section. A common pain point is that the client declines to provide the full formulation development history on the grounds of "trade secrets", although this information is essential for the receiving unit to understand the critical points of the process.

blocks.zh: 解決方案：在 Quality Agreement（品質協議）中事先約定哪些資訊必須提供，並在 TT 提案階段即取得雙方共識。
blocks.en: Solution: agree in advance in the Quality Agreement which information must be provided, and reach consensus between both parties at the TT proposal stage.

blocks.zh: Ishikawa 圖（石川圖）在 TT 中的角色
blocks.en: The Role of the Ishikawa Diagram in TT

blocks.zh: Appendix 6 中提到 Ishikawa（魚骨圖）作為製程知識轉移的工具。其重要性在於：它將影響 CQA（如溶出度、含量均勻性）的因素視覺化分類——材料、設備、人員、環境、方法——讓接收端工程師能快速識別「哪些因子是關鍵的，哪些是次要的」。
blocks.en: Appendix 6 mentions the Ishikawa (fishbone) diagram as a tool for process knowledge transfer. Its value is that it visually categorizes the factors affecting CQAs (such as dissolution and content uniformity) into materials, equipment, people, environment and methods, so that receiving unit engineers can quickly see "which factors are critical and which are secondary".

blocks.zh: 在技術轉移中，發送端應特別標記「在工程研究中確認為顯著因子」的項目（加粗呈現），避免接收端重蹈舊坑。
blocks.en: In a technology transfer, the sending unit should specifically flag the items "confirmed as significant factors in engineering studies" (shown in bold) so that the receiving unit does not repeat past mistakes.

blocks.zh: 如果客戶只提供了批次製造記錄（MBR），但沒有配方開發史或風險評估報告，CDMO 作為接收端應如何處理？這對 TT 成功率有何影響？
blocks.en: If the client provides only the master batch record (MBR) but no formulation development history or risk assessment report, how should the CDMO, as the receiving unit, respond? What does this mean for the likelihood of TT success?

blocks.zh: 「PPQ 結果」與「製程驗證報告」有何不同？在技術轉移完成後，接收端需要做哪些額外的驗證活動？
blocks.en: How do "PPQ results" differ from a "process validation report"? After the technology transfer is complete, what additional validation activities does the receiving unit need to perform?

blocks.zh: Appendix 7 — References Appendix 7 — 參考文獻
blocks.en: Appendix 7 — References

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 技術轉移的法規錨點文件
blocks.en: Core Concepts — Regulatory Anchor Documents for Technology Transfer

blocks.zh: 44 篇參考文獻中，最重要的法規錨點可分為三層：
blocks.en: Of the 44 references, the most important regulatory anchors fall into three tiers:

blocks.zh: 第一層 — ICH 核心三劍客（必讀）：
blocks.en: Tier 1 — The ICH core trio (must-read):

blocks.zh: ICH Q10（藥品品質系統）：定義 TT 是 PQS 的核心要素之一，要求發送端與接收端均需有文件化的 TT 程序。
blocks.en: ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System): defines TT as one of the core elements of the PQS and requires both the sending and receiving units to have a documented TT procedure.

blocks.zh: ICH Q8(R2)（藥品開發）：QbD 框架，定義 QTPP、CQA、CPP，奠定 TT 知識包裝的科學基礎。
blocks.en: ICH Q8(R2) (Pharmaceutical Development): the QbD framework, which defines QTPP, CQA and CPP and provides the scientific basis for packaging TT knowledge.

blocks.zh: ICH Q9（品質風險管理）：FMEA 的方法論出處，TT 風險評估的法規依據。
blocks.en: ICH Q9 (Quality Risk Management): the source of the FMEA methodology and the regulatory basis for TT risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 第二層 — 製程驗證：
blocks.en: Tier 2 — Process validation:

blocks.zh: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011)：三階段驗證模型（Process Design → PPQ → Continued Verification），所有美國市場產品必須遵循。
blocks.en: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011): the three-stage validation model (Process Design → PPQ → Continued Verification), which all products for the US market must follow.

blocks.zh: EMA Process Validation Guideline (2016)：歐盟市場要求，概念相似但術語略異（如「Concurrent Validation」的接受度不同）。
blocks.en: EMA Process Validation Guideline (2016): the requirement for the EU market; the concepts are similar but the terminology differs slightly (for example, "Concurrent Validation" is accepted differently).

blocks.zh: 第三層 — 分析方法轉移：
blocks.en: Tier 3 — Analytical method transfer:

blocks.zh: USP <1224>：分析方法轉移的程序指引（等效測試法、聯合驗證法、放棄轉移直接再驗證）。
blocks.en: USP <1224>: procedural guidance for analytical method transfer (comparative testing, covalidation, and waiver of transfer with direct revalidation).

blocks.zh: ICH Q2(R1)：分析方法驗證的基礎標準。
blocks.en: ICH Q2(R1): the foundational standard for analytical method validation.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — ICH Q11 與藥物原料的 TT
blocks.en: Key Point — ICH Q11 and TT of Drug Substances

blocks.zh: ICH Q11（藥物原料開發與製造）是處理 API（Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient）技術轉移時的關鍵文件，特別是針對生物藥（biologic）的起始物料和生產步驟定義。對 CDMO 而言，當客戶需要將 API 生產線轉移時，ICH Q11 決定了哪些資訊必須揭露給監管機構。
blocks.en: ICH Q11 (Development and Manufacture of Drug Substances) is the key document when handling the technology transfer of an API (Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient), particularly regarding the definition of starting materials and manufacturing steps for biologics. For a CDMO, when a client needs to transfer an API production line, ICH Q11 determines which information must be disclosed to regulators.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — ICH Q5E：生物藥可比性
blocks.en: Key Point — ICH Q5E: Comparability of Biologics

blocks.zh: ICH Q5E 是處理生物製品（biotechnological/biological products）在製程變更後可比性評估的專用指引。當生物藥 CDMO 在技術轉移後，需要向 FDA/EMA 提交可比性數據時，ICH Q5E 定義了需要進行的分析、功能性和臨床數據層級。這是無菌注射生物藥 TT 的關鍵法規文件。
blocks.en: ICH Q5E is the dedicated guideline for assessing the comparability of biotechnological/biological products after a process change. When a biologics CDMO must submit comparability data to FDA/EMA after a technology transfer, ICH Q5E defines the levels of analytical, functional and clinical data required. It is a key regulatory document for the TT of sterile injectable biologics.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 法規錨點的作用
blocks.en: Analogy — What Regulatory Anchors Do

blocks.zh: 法規錨點文件就像法庭上的判例法。當稽查員質疑你的 TT 做法時，你不是靠「我覺得這樣做很合理」來辯護，而是指向具體的 ICH 指引：「根據 ICH Q10 第 X.X 節……根據 FDA Process Validation Guidance 第 Y 節……」。有了這些錨點，你的 TT 決策才有法規可溯源性（regulatory traceability）。
blocks.en: Regulatory anchor documents are like case law in a courtroom. When an inspector questions your TT approach, you do not defend it by saying "I think this is reasonable"; you point to a specific ICH guideline: "According to ICH Q10 section X.X ... according to section Y of the FDA Process Validation Guidance ...". With these anchors, your TT decisions have regulatory traceability.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 法規準備
blocks.en: Practical Application — CDMO Regulatory Preparation

blocks.zh: 建議 CDMO 技術服務團隊建立一份「法規文件矩陣」，橫軸是各 TT 活動（製程轉移、方法轉移、驗證、穩定性），縱軸是對應的 ICH/FDA/EMA 參考文件。每次 TT 報告都能快速引用正確的法規依據，並在回應 FDA 483 觀察事項時展現法規素養。
blocks.en: CDMO technical services teams are advised to build a "regulatory document matrix", with the TT activities (process transfer, method transfer, validation, stability) on the horizontal axis and the corresponding ICH/FDA/EMA reference documents on the vertical axis. Every TT report can then quickly cite the correct regulatory basis, and the team can demonstrate regulatory literacy when responding to FDA 483 observations.

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 如何定義「技術轉移」？它與 ICH Q8(R2) 的 QbD 框架如何相互呼應？
blocks.en: How does ICH Q10 define "technology transfer"? How does it correspond with the QbD framework of ICH Q8(R2)?

blocks.zh: FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011) 的三階段模型，在技術轉移情境下，「第一階段（製程設計）」的責任由誰承擔——發送端還是接收端？
blocks.en: In the three-stage model of the FDA Process Validation Guidance (2011), who bears responsibility for "Stage 1 (Process Design)" in a technology transfer, the sending unit or the receiving unit?

blocks.zh: 如果你正在做一個從歐洲發送端到台灣接收端的無菌製程 TT，你需要同時遵循 FDA 和 EMA 的驗證指引嗎？理由是什麼？
blocks.en: If you are carrying out a sterile process TT from a European sending unit to a receiving unit in Taiwan, must you comply with both the FDA and EMA validation guidance? Why?

blocks.zh: Appendix 8 — Glossary: 15.1 Acronyms and Abbreviations Appendix 8 — 詞彙表：15.1 縮寫
blocks.en: Appendix 8 — Glossary: 15.1 Acronyms and Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 縮寫分組記憶法
blocks.en: Core Concepts — Grouping Acronyms to Remember Them

blocks.zh: 將 50 個縮寫依功能分類，有助快速掌握：
blocks.en: Grouping the 50 acronyms by function helps you master them quickly:

blocks.zh: 品質系統類： CQA、CPP、QTPP、QbD、QRM、PQS、CAPA — 這是 QbD 框架的核心語彙，貫穿所有 ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 文件。
blocks.en: Quality system: CQA, CPP, QTPP, QbD, QRM, PQS, CAPA — the core vocabulary of the QbD framework, running through all ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 documents.

blocks.zh: 組織與角色類： CDMO、CMO、SME、RACI、FTE — 描述技術轉移專案的人員結構。
blocks.en: Organizations and roles: CDMO, CMO, SME, RACI, FTE — describing the people structure of a technology transfer project.

blocks.zh: 製程工程類： PAT、CPV、PPQ、OEE、BFD、PFD、P&ID — 描述製程設計與監控。
blocks.en: Process engineering: PAT, CPV, PPQ, OEE, BFD, PFD, P&ID — describing process design and monitoring.

blocks.zh: 分析方法類： ATP、HPLC、AEX、LOD — 分析方法開發與轉移的核心術語。
blocks.en: Analytical methods: ATP, HPLC, AEX, LOD — core terms in analytical method development and transfer.

blocks.zh: 監管機構類： FDA、EMA、ICH、WHO、NIHS、PIC/S — TT 必須遵循的各地法規體系。
blocks.en: Regulatory bodies: FDA, EMA, ICH, WHO, NIHS, PIC/S — the regional regulatory systems that TT must comply with.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 最易混淆的縮寫對
blocks.en: Key Point — The Most Easily Confused Acronym Pairs

blocks.zh: CPV vs. CQV：Continued Process Verification（製程持續確認）vs. Continued Quality Verification（品質持續確認）。CPV 是 FDA 三階段驗證的第三階段，CQV 是更廣義的術語。
blocks.en: CPV vs. CQV: Continued Process Verification vs. Continued Quality Verification. CPV is Stage 3 of the FDA three-stage validation model; CQV is a broader term.

blocks.zh: PPQ vs. PV：PPQ（製程性能確效）是 FDA 術語指商業製程驗證批次；PV（Process Validation）是通稱。在 TT 情境中，PPQ 批次是接收端展示製程可重現性的核心證據。
blocks.en: PPQ vs. PV: PPQ (Process Performance Qualification) is the FDA term for the commercial process validation batches; PV (Process Validation) is the general term. In a TT context, the PPQ batches are the core evidence by which the receiving unit demonstrates process reproducibility.

blocks.zh: CDMO vs. CMO：CDMO 涵蓋開發（Development）能力，CMO 僅代工製造。在技術轉移中，CDMO 可能同時扮演開發合作夥伴與製造接收端。
blocks.en: CDMO vs. CMO: A CDMO includes Development capability, whereas a CMO only does contract manufacturing. In a technology transfer, a CDMO may act as both development partner and manufacturing receiving unit.

blocks.zh: MBR vs. SOP：MBR（主批次記錄）是特定產品每批次的生產指令；SOP 是通用操作程序。TT 時兩者都需要從發送端轉移或重新建立。
blocks.en: MBR vs. SOP: The MBR (Master Batch Record) is the production instruction for each batch of a specific product; an SOP is a general operating procedure. In a TT, both must be transferred from the sending unit or re-established.

blocks.zh: RACI 矩陣（Responsible/Accountable/Consulted/Informed）在技術轉移中如何應用？發送端 QA 在 RACI 中通常扮演哪個角色？
blocks.en: How is the RACI matrix (Responsible/Accountable/Consulted/Informed) applied in technology transfer? Which role does sending unit QA usually play in the RACI?

blocks.zh: ATP（Analytical Target Profile）與 QTPP（Quality Target Product Profile）的關係是什麼？為什麼分析方法轉移前需要先確認 ATP？
blocks.en: What is the relationship between the ATP (Analytical Target Profile) and the QTPP (Quality Target Product Profile)? Why must the ATP be confirmed before an analytical method transfer?

blocks.zh: Appendix 8 — Glossary: 15.2 Definitions Appendix 8 — 詞彙表：15.2 定義
blocks.en: Appendix 8 — Glossary: 15.2 Definitions

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 最常混淆的術語對照
blocks.en: Core Concepts — Comparison of the Most Confused Terms

blocks.zh: 以下五組術語在技術轉移實務中最常被混淆，必須釐清：
blocks.en: The following five pairs of terms are the ones most often confused in technology transfer practice and must be clarified:

blocks.zh: 1. Technology Transfer Package（技術轉移包裝）vs. Technology Transfer Proposal（技術轉移提案）
blocks.en: 1. Technology Transfer Package vs. Technology Transfer Proposal

blocks.zh: 「提案」是專案範疇文件——在 TT 開始前寫，定義目標、團隊、時程、成功標準。「包裝」是技術知識集合體——包含運行製程和分析產品所需的全部知識，是 TT 的實質內容，在整個 TT 過程中持續補充完善。
blocks.en: The "proposal" is a project scope document: written before the TT begins, it defines the objectives, team, timeline and success criteria. The "package" is a collection of technical knowledge: it contains all the knowledge needed to run the process and analyze the product, it is the substance of the TT, and it is continuously supplemented and refined throughout the TT.

blocks.zh: 2. Technology Transfer Plan（計畫）vs. Technology Transfer Charter（憲章）
blocks.en: 2. Technology Transfer Plan vs. Technology Transfer Charter

blocks.zh: 「憲章」是高層次的策略性文件，確保發送端和接收端管理層對專案範疇和目標有共識。「計畫」是更詳細的執行層文件，列出具體技術和管理任務。
blocks.en: The "charter" is a high-level strategic document that ensures the sending and receiving unit management share an understanding of the project scope and objectives. The "plan" is a more detailed execution-level document that lists the specific technical and management tasks.

blocks.zh: QMS（品質管理系統）是 ISO 通用概念，適用於任何行業。PQS（藥品品質系統）是 ICH Q10 定義的製藥專用版本，特別包含了產品生命週期管理和持續改善的要求。
blocks.en: A QMS (Quality Management System) is a general ISO concept applicable to any industry. A PQS (Pharmaceutical Quality System) is the pharma-specific version defined by ICH Q10, and in particular includes requirements for product lifecycle management and continual improvement.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 三種「製程驗證」定義的差異
blocks.en: Key Point — Differences Among the Three Definitions of "Process Validation"

blocks.zh: 附錄 8 特別列出 FDA、EMA、ICH Q8(R2) 對製程驗證（Process Validation）的三種定義，差異耐人尋味：
blocks.en: Appendix 8 specifically lists the FDA, EMA and ICH Q8(R2) definitions of Process Validation, and the differences are instructive:

blocks.zh: FDA（2011）：強調「從製程設計到商業生產的全生命週期數據收集」。重點在科學證據的系統性積累。
blocks.en: FDA (2011): emphasizes "data collection throughout the lifecycle from process design through commercial production". The focus is the systematic accumulation of scientific evidence.

blocks.zh: EMA：強調「在既定參數內操作的文件化證據，能有效且可重現地生產符合規格的產品」。偏向批次重現性的書面佐證。
blocks.en: EMA: emphasizes "documented evidence that the process, operated within established parameters, can perform effectively and reproducibly to produce a product meeting its specifications". It leans toward written proof of batch reproducibility.

blocks.zh: ICH Q8(R2)：定義與 QbD 相同——「以預定目標為起點，強調製程理解與管控的系統性開發方法」。這說明在 QbD 框架下，驗證不是事後補救，而是從開發之初就建立的。
blocks.en: ICH Q8(R2): the definition is the same as for QbD, "a systematic approach to development that begins with predefined objectives and emphasizes process understanding and control". This shows that under the QbD framework, validation is not a remedy applied after the fact but is built in from the start of development.

blocks.zh: 在 TT 技術報告中，建議明確引用目標市場對應的定義，避免監管機構誤解。
blocks.en: In the TT technical report, it is advisable to cite explicitly the definition that applies to the target market, to avoid misinterpretation by regulators.

blocks.zh: 延伸解析 — Sending Unit vs. Receiving Unit 的對等義務
blocks.en: Extended Analysis — The Reciprocal Obligations of the Sending Unit and Receiving Unit

blocks.zh: 術語表特別強調兩個單位的定義是「鏡像對稱」的——均包含「核心功能與輔助功能」。這個措辭提示了一個關鍵原則：技術轉移是雙向責任，不是單向「交付」。
blocks.en: The glossary deliberately defines the two units in "mirror-image" terms, both including "core functions and supporting functions". This wording signals a key principle: technology transfer is a two-way responsibility, not a one-way "handover".

blocks.zh: 發送端的義務：提供完整、準確的技術知識包裝（Technology Transfer Package）。
blocks.en: Obligation of the sending unit: to provide a complete and accurate technology transfer package of technical knowledge (Technology Transfer Package).

blocks.zh: 接收端的義務：有能力接收、理解並複現這些知識，並提供充分的基礎設施和合格的人員。
blocks.en: Obligation of the receiving unit: to be capable of receiving, understanding and reproducing that knowledge, and to provide adequate infrastructure and qualified personnel.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 合約中，如果 TT 失敗，責任歸屬往往取決於哪一方未能履行其相應義務。
blocks.en: In a CDMO contract, if a TT fails, responsibility often depends on which party failed to fulfill its corresponding obligations.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — Control Strategy 是什麼
blocks.en: Analogy — What Is a Control Strategy?

blocks.zh: 控制策略（Control Strategy）就像一架飛機的「安全系統矩陣」。它不只是一個儀表或一個警報——它是從駕駛艙儀表盤、自動駕駛儀、機師培訓、維護記錄到空管通訊的完整管控體系。在製藥製程中，Control Strategy 涵蓋：原料規格、設備條件、IPC 頻率、成品規格、監測方法——這套體系整體保證每批產品都安全有效。
blocks.en: A Control Strategy is like an aircraft's "safety system matrix". It is not just one gauge or one alarm; it is a complete control system running from the cockpit instrument panel, autopilot, pilot training and maintenance records to air traffic control communications. In a pharmaceutical process, the Control Strategy covers raw material specifications, equipment conditions, IPC frequency, finished product specifications and monitoring methods, and the system as a whole assures that every batch is safe and effective.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Stakeholder（利害關係人）的優先排序
blocks.en: Key Point — The Order of Priority Among Stakeholders

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 對 Stakeholder 的定義明確點名四個主要利害關係人：患者 > 醫療專業人員 > 監管機構 > 產業。這個排序有深刻的法規含義：在任何決策（包括 TT 決策）中，當這四方利益衝突時，患者利益必須優先。
blocks.en: The ICH Q9 definition of Stakeholder explicitly names four main stakeholders: patient > healthcare professional > regulator > industry. This ranking has deep regulatory significance: in any decision (including TT decisions), when the interests of these four parties conflict, the patient's interest must take priority.

blocks.zh: 在技術轉移的情境下，「接受稍微降低的效率以確保產品品質可比性」永遠是正確決策，因為最終受影響的是患者。
blocks.en: In a technology transfer, "accepting slightly reduced efficiency to ensure product quality comparability" is always the right decision, because it is the patient who is ultimately affected.

blocks.zh: QTPP（Quality Target Product Profile）是在 TT 的哪個階段建立的？它在 TT 過程中如何被用來評估接收端的製程是否達到「成功轉移」的標準？
blocks.en: At which stage of the TT is the QTPP (Quality Target Product Profile) established? How is it used during the TT to assess whether the receiving unit's process meets the criteria for a "successful transfer"?

blocks.zh: 請解釋 Technology Transfer Package 與 Technology Transfer Plan 的區別，並說明如果 Package 不完整，Plan 的執行會面臨哪些挑戰。
blocks.en: Explain the difference between the Technology Transfer Package and the Technology Transfer Plan, and describe the challenges the execution of the Plan will face if the Package is incomplete.

blocks.zh: 為何附錄特別為 PAT（Process Analytical Technology）提供定義？PAT 在技術轉移中扮演什麼角色？發送端若使用 PAT，接收端是否需要使用相同的 PAT 設備？
blocks.en: Why does the appendix provide a definition specifically for PAT (Process Analytical Technology)? What role does PAT play in technology transfer? If the sending unit uses PAT, must the receiving unit use the same PAT equipment?

blocks.zh: 本章重點回顧 Appendices 5–8 Summary
blocks.en: Chapter Summary: Appendices 5–8 Summary

blocks.zh: Appendix 5 — FMEA：RPN = SEV × OCC × DET；偵測度 8/10 = 偵測能力弱；RPN ≥ 100–125 通常需要行動；無菌製程的 SEV 普遍高於非無菌製程（無菌性、微粒、CCI 失效均 SEV = 9–10）
blocks.en: Appendix 5 — FMEA: RPN = SEV × OCC × DET; detectability of 8/10 = weak detection capability; action is usually required at RPN ≥ 100–125; SEV in sterile processes is generally higher than in non-sterile processes (sterility, particulate and CCI failures are all SEV = 9–10)

blocks.zh: Appendix 6 — TT 報告：完整報告應包含開發資訊、生產資訊、設備確效、清潔驗證、PPQ 結果六大模組；是 CMC 法規申報的核心證據文件；雙方 QA 簽署為完成的法規標誌
blocks.en: Appendix 6 — TT Report: a complete report should contain six major modules: development information, production information, equipment qualification, cleaning validation, PPQ results and approval signatures; it is the core evidence document for CMC regulatory filings; QA sign-off by both parties is the regulatory marker of completion

blocks.zh: Appendix 7 — 參考文獻：法規錨點三層次：ICH Q8/Q9/Q10（框架）→ FDA/EMA Process Validation（驗證）→ USP <1224>/ICH Q2（分析方法）；ICH Q5E 為生物藥可比性專用指引
blocks.en: Appendix 7 — References: three tiers of regulatory anchors: ICH Q8/Q9/Q10 (framework) → FDA/EMA Process Validation (validation) → USP <1224>/ICH Q2 (analytical methods); ICH Q5E is the dedicated guideline for biologics comparability

blocks.zh: Appendix 8 — 術語表：最易混淆術語：TT Package（知識集合體）vs. TT Proposal（範疇文件）vs. TT Plan（執行細節）vs. TT Charter（策略共識）；PQS 是製藥專用的 QMS；製程驗證的 FDA/EMA/ICH 定義各有側重
blocks.en: Appendix 8 — Glossary: the most confusing terms: TT Package (knowledge collection) vs. TT Proposal (scope document) vs. TT Plan (execution detail) vs. TT Charter (strategic consensus); PQS is the pharma-specific QMS; the FDA/EMA/ICH definitions of process validation each have a different emphasis

blocks.zh: 跨附錄關鍵洞見：FMEA（App 5）的風險評估結果應直接驅動 TT 報告（App 6）中的行動項目，並以 ICH Q9（App 7）為法規依據，所有相關術語均在術語表（App 8）中有明確定義——四個附錄構成一套完整的風險管理閉環
blocks.en: Key cross-appendix insight: the risk assessment results of the FMEA (App 5) should directly drive the action items in the TT report (App 6), with ICH Q9 (App 7) as the regulatory basis, and all related terms are clearly defined in the glossary (App 8); together the four appendices form a complete risk management closed loop
